notes: Breadboard bottom half (rows a-e in the image) is mapped to bank 't' per the catalogue naming.
Buzzer legs are assumed to sit in holes 15t.b (negative, black) and 18t.b (positive, purple); the jumper wires share the same columns in row a, so they connect via the column strip.
Buzzer port 1 is assumed to be the positive (long) leg and port 2 the negative leg.
The black wire goes to the Pi GND pin at physical pin 9 (GND.2), next to GPIO17 on the lower header row (pin 11), per the image highlights.
No resistor is used in the circuit; the Pi is not powered/connected to anything else in the manual.
